container_paths_cuda13: Container is CUDA 13-based; CIPHER substrate built against CUDA 12; ABI version mismatch
F-B.3.3_full_dt_needed_chain.root_cause: v0.21.0 vllm-openai container ships CUDA 13 runtime libs. CIPHER substrate (Phase A close 1d91e7da) was built linking against CUDA 12 toolkit. The version skew means container's libs are not direct substitutes (libcudart.so.12 != libcudart.so.13 SONAME).
remediation_candidates: Option 2-extended (cheapest, ~0.1 ED on top of R1): augment CIPHER_CUPTI_CANDIDATES into a generalized CIPHER_HOST_CUDA12_LIBS list including {libcudart.so.12, libcusolver.so.11, libnvJitLink.so.12, libcusparse.so.12, libcublas.so.12, libcublasLt.so.12}; CDI patch bind-mounts each at /usr/lib/cipher/<name> with same fallback discovery. 6 additional mount entries (final libs in /usr/lib/cipher/).
Option 6 (image pin): downgrade v1 target to an older vllm-openai tag that uses CUDA 12. Brittle for v1.x as vLLM ecosystem moves to CUDA 13.

Option 7 (substrate carve-out): rebuild libcipher_rt.so with dlopen-on-demand resolution for the full CUDA 12 toolkit (CP 3.3 telemetry + cublas interception both env-gated). Major substrate work; ~3-5 ED; v1.5 carry candidate.
F-B.3.3_full_dt_needed_chain.recommendation: Option 2-extended. ~0.1 ED extension of R1. Preserves Goal 5 verbatim (still no customer-side action; CIPHER bind-mounts more host libs via CDI). Option 7 is the right long-term answer (one-time substrate rebuild eliminates host-CUDA-12-ABI coupling) but is v1.5 scope per honest-residue discipline.
considerations: Option 2-extended adds 6 host bind-mounts to CDI; total CIPHER mount count grows from 14 to 20. Still well under nvidia's own mount count (18+) and far under any spec limit.
Each bind-mount adds /usr/lib/cipher/<libname> to container's CIPHER lib dir; LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/usr/lib/cipher already set so they all resolve. No env change needed.

The chain is libcipher_rt -> libcublas/libcublasLt -> libnvJitLink/libcusparse/libcusolver/libcudart. All 6 are at the host's standard /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/ path on this pod (nvidia-cuda-toolkit 12.8.93 installed). On a different neocloud host with CUDA toolkit in a non-standard path, the same fallback discovery (/usr/local/cuda*/lib*/) covers most cases.

Honest residue carry to v1.5: 'v1 takes a runtime dependency on host CUDA 12 toolkit ABI (libcudart, libcusolver, libnvJitLink, libcusparse, libcublas, libcublasLt, libcupti all at major version 12); v1.5 rebuilds libcipher_rt.so with dlopen-on-demand CUDA toolkit resolution to support hosts on CUDA 13.x without explicit toolkit installation.'
